say:1:1035716001:1.text: I didn't do anything! I just thought this place was strange, so I came to investigate during the day.
say:1:1035716001:1.source_cn: 我什么都没干！只不过是觉得这里很奇怪，趁着白天过来看看而已。
say:1:1035716001:1.male: I didn't do anything! I just thought this place was strange, so I came to investigate during the day.

say:2:1035716002:1.text: As for you, what are you doing sneaking around like this?
